name: cron_dump
description: Collect every scheduled job on a Linux host into one list: /etc/crontab, /etc/cron.d, the per-user spool, the hourly to monthly drop directories, and systemd timers with the unit each one triggers.

root.description: The root of an extracted file system, or / on a live host

contains.description: Case-insensitive regex over the command or unit
